title: Angular Software Engineer
description:
Angular Software Engineer
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. Experience great flexibility, under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, and Thessaloniki, while benefiting from personalized learning and career development opportunities. We prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion, fostering an environment where everyone's unique perspectives are valued, that supports you in building an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. The opportunityWe are currently seeking highly motivated persons to work as Software Engineers for our IT Consulting, a leading provider of Technology services to large corporate clients of all industries. As a member of our team:
You will have a significant technical contribution to large-scale implementation projects
You will be given the opportunity to work and take responsibility in challenging engagements in Greece and abroad
Your ability to learn and apply advanced Technology solutions, will give you the opportunity to grow professionally and participate in the design and deployment of leading-edge technologies.

Skills and attributes for success To qualify for the role you must have

A Bachelor's degree in one of the fields of Computer Science, Software Engineering, or other related discipline
Ability to work as a team member
Self-motivated to contribute with your own ideas - showcase the feasibility and benefits with a proof of concept and document your cutting edge solution
Experience in Java or other object-oriented programming language
Completed military obligations (where applicable)

Ideally, you'll also have

Experience in SQL and PL/SQL
Working experience with at least one RDBMS e.g. Oracle (preferably), SQL Server, DB2, MySQL, PostgreSQL etc.
Familiarity with IDE tools e.g. JDeveloper (preferably), Visual Studio etc.
Knowledge and/or experience with web services (SOAP, JSON/REST)
Knowledge and/or experience with Oracle ADF
Knowledge and/or experience with Angular, Ionic or Node.js
Knowledge and/or experience with source control software (e.g. GIT, SVN, TFS)
Ability to design and develop solutions with business users (feel free to include relevant project and profile links, like GitHub, Kaggle or Stack Overflow)
Work experience either in Insurance sector, or in a solution provider environment engaged with Insurance projects implementation

What we look for What's most important is that you're dedicated to working with your colleagues as part of a high-performing team. You'll need to demonstrate enthusiasm, high motivation and passion to develop fast in a multinational working environment. You'll need to thrive in picking up new skills and talents as you go, so natural curiosity, a lot of questions and the
confidence to speak up when you see something that could be improved are essential. If you've got the right combination of technical knowledge and communication skills, this role is for you. What we offer What we offer
Competitive remuneration package: You'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Depending on your experience, our comprehensive rewards package includes benefits that suit your needs including cutting-edge technological equipment, ticket restaurant vouchers, a private health insurance scheme, life insurance, income protection and an exclusive EY benefits club that provides a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. 
Flexible working arrangements: We operate under a hybrid working model, which is defined based on both your own preferences and team's needs, and we enjoy our summers with short Fridays.
Personalized learning experience and career development: We provide free and unlimited access to educational platforms and EY Badges, support certifications, and provide coaching and feedback, as a part of our Leadership & Development process, all of which can lead to a meaningful impact and success as defined by you.
Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
International Experience: Become part of international projects and work along multicultural teams, through our global network.
Above all, you will be working in one of the most recognized employers in Greece, as we have been awarded the Top Employers, Great Place to Work and Best Workplaces for Women awards for 2024.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build. Apply now.EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. title: Senior Associate, Software Engineering
description:
Role Summary
Pfizer's purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that change patients' lives.In Pfizer Digital Core Solutions, we partner closely with our Pfizer business operations colleagues to efficiently deliver robust supporting technology solutions that enhance their work to achieve the Pfizer purpose. We value our team members' technical skills, but also their passion, teamwork, and growth. Our culture is focused on delivering value through courage, excellence, equity, and joy. Our collective skillset supports all aspects of technology planning, project execution and application development excellence.We are looking for Software Engineer (SE) candidates who are aligned with our culture and values, and with academic and/or work experience in software development projects that include both backend and frontend development using Java and Javascript-based technologies for multi-tiered, RDBMS-based web applications.The Software Engineer plays a key role in meeting our mission. The SE analyzes specifications, designs logic, writes code, customizes products, unit tests, debugs, and documents software applications. The SE participates in agile team events and works within the agile team framework.The SE will work closely with their manager to ensure growth over time, including the selection of project work among hundreds of applications that will expand their skillset to meet personal and organizational goals, to provide fulfilling work, and to advance their careers.
Role Responsibilities

Works within project teams as a contributor to design, prototype, implement and unit test software solutions in support of the project objectives.
Works as a senior developer on small-to-medium size software development projects, which may include accountability for the work of a small number of other junior and/or contract Software Engineers, as well as responsibility for dictating and managing coding standards, coding best practices, source code control approaches, versioning, etc.
Translates logical designs of user/system interfaces into physical designs, considering the target environment, performance requirements and existing systems.
Helps produce detailed design specifications where applicable, and documents all work using required standards, methods, and tools, including prototyping tools, where appropriate.
Conducts reviews of supplied specifications as appropriate.
Defines the integration build and produces a build definition for generation of the software.
Work in a matrix, team environment with Pfizer colleagues as well as vendor partners.
Dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers.

Qualifications
Education:

Undergraduate degree in Software Engineering, Information Management, Computer Science, Mathematics, or other scientific or engineering discipline.

Prior Experience:

Minimum of 3 years of experience as a software developer/engineer.

Required Capabilities and Experience:

Facilitation, negotiating and presentation skills.
Experience working in ambiguous situations.
Demonstrated experience and skills in analysis and problem solving.
Demonstrated ability to developing multi-tiered solutions using multiple programming languages and web technologies including Java, TypeScript (Angular), HTML, CSS, SQL, etc.
Demonstrated experience using standard requirements business analysis techniques, including brainstorming, interviewing, requirements sessions, activity diagrams and use cases desired.
Demonstrated experience and/or competencies either informally or formally contributing on various-size teams of technologists, IT professionals or project managers using Agile, Scrum, DevOps, and other approaches for iterative development.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work effectively in team settings, frequently in virtual teams with client partner and customer engagement responsibilities.
Demonstrated ability to understand data and integration architectures to manage, transform, and exploit data across the enterprise.
Demonstrated capability to understand security requirements, and using the frameworks and tools the organization has put in place to meet those requirements.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.

Required Aptitude:

Quick to establish trust and respect
Action oriented and energetic
Resourceful and creative
Persistent and determined
Mature and cool under pressure
Easily makes connections
Reads situations quickly
Commitment and follow through

title: Junior Java Developer / DevOps Engineer (Remote/Thessaloniki)
AI/ML Senior Associate Scientist
description:
ROLE SUMMARYAs a core member of our AI/ML, Quantitative & Digital Sciences (AQDS) team, you will:

Design, implement, and maintain full-stack applications that integrate advanced Machine Learning (ML) techniques with internal and external data sources.
Develop and apply generative AI techniques using large language models (LLMs) to automate the generation of essential clinical trial documents.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to architect and develop scalable, cloud-native microservices and APIs for AI/ML tools aimed at optimizing patient recruitment, site selection, and clinical trial management, incorporating generative AI capabilities to streamline authoring workflows.
Leverage modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue) to build intuitive user interfaces that provide real-time insights from ML models and facilitate decision-making for clinical operations, including AI-generated document review and customization.
Work closely with DevOps and data engineering teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines, automate infrastructure as code (IaC), and ensure secure deployment of AI/ML models, including generative AI systems, across cloud environments (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
Implement AI/ML models in full-stack systems, ensuring robust backend processing and efficient front-end data visualization.
Engage with both internal and external stakeholders to continuously bring the latest advancements in generative AI, full-stack development, and AI/ML technologies to Pfizer, contributing to thought leadership through publications and presentations.





ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Partner with key therapy areas (e.g., Immunology & Inflammation, Oncology, Internal Medicine) to identify scientific and technical challenges, define data pipelines, and implement full-stack solutions that leverage AI/ML methods, including generative AI models, to generate actionable insights and automate clinical trial documentation.
Translate complex clinical data and analytics requirements into full-stack digital products, ensuring that development priorities align with the overall clinical development goals.
Lead the end-to-end development of full-stack applications, from database schema design and API development to front-end user interfaces, ensuring seamless integration with AI/ML workflows and LLM-powered document generation systems.
Supervise and guide the deployment of robust back-end services that support predictive and classification algorithms, as well as generative AI models, ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
Develop and maintain dashboards and data visualization tools that provide clinical and operational teams with real-time analytics and insights driven by advanced ML models, while integrating tools for generating and reviewing AI-authored clinical trial documents.
Maintain an active external network in the AI/ML, generative AI, and full-stack development communities, continuously monitoring state-of-the-art capabilities and evaluating their potential impact on Pfizer's development teams.





QUALIFICATIONSBasic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in full-stack development in the pharma, biotech, or tech industry.
Proficient in full-stack development, including back-end technologies (Node.js, Django, Flask) and front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue).
Strong understanding of database technologies (SQL, NoSQL) and experience in designing RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.
Experience with AI/ML model integration, including developing APIs to interface with ML models and building front-end components for real-time data visualization.
Experience working with large language models (LLMs) for generative AI applications.
Strong programming skills (Python, JavaScript, R) and familiarity with cloud technologies (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation tools (Terraform, Ansible).
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a technical or scientific discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Computational Biology, Engineering).
Hands-on experience with the full-stack development of clinical trial management systems, focusing on integrating AI/ML-driven insights into clinical workflows, and automating document generation through LLMs.
Proven experience leading end-to-end clinicaldevelopment projects, particularly in Phases 2 and 3, from study design to regulatory submission.
Experience with data engineering workflows, including ETL processes, data lakes, and scalable data architectures.
Prior experience working with distributed teams across multiple time zones is a plus.

title: Manager, Software Engineer
description:

Technology impacts everything we do. Pfizer's digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives.ROLE SUMMARYPfizer's purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that change patients' lives.In Pfizer Digital Core Solutions, we partner closely with our Pfizer business operations colleagues to efficiently deliver robust supporting technology solutions that enhance their work to achieve the Pfizer purpose. We value our team members' technical skills, but also their passion, teamwork, and growth. Our culture is focused on delivering value through courage, excellence, equity, and joy. Our collective skillset supports all aspects of technology planning, project execution and application development excellence.We are looking for Software Engineer (SE) candidates who are aligned with our culture and values, and with experience in software development projects that include both backend and frontend development using Java and Javascript-based technologies for multi-tiered, RDBMS-based web applications. Top candidates will also have experience working on regulated projects that have used an agile approach.The Software Engineer plays a key role in meeting our mission. In addition to standard software development and agile team responsibilities, SEs act as mentors as well as technical subject matter experts on in-house, outsourced, and co-sourced developed global applications. SEs may additionally lead technical teams and work independently or lead others on initiatives. SEs will collaborate closely with stakeholders of all levels across both the Digital Core Solutions organization as well as our partner business operations organizations, leading to opportunities to learn from and advise senior Pfizer leadership.The SE will work closely with their manager to ensure growth over time, including the selection of project work among hundreds of applications that will expand their skillset to meet personal and organizational goals, to provide fulfilling work, and to advance their careers.

Creates, improves, and maintains DevOps and other build and code management configurations to support efficient, high quality, and secure software development and delivery.

5+ years of relevant experience within the Software Engineering discipline.
Experience working within teams of technologists, IT professionals or project managers using Agile, DevOps, and other approaches for iterative development.
Demonstrated capabilities and experience collaborating and working effectively in team settings, frequently in virtual teams with client partner and customer engagement responsibilities.
Experience in supporting the selection or implementation of technical direction on large projects and/or complex, program-level initiatives requiring technical and business-domain expertise.
Experience and demonstrated competencies either informally or formally managing and/or mentoring others with an emphasis on communicating software engineering and project development best practices.

title: AI and Data Science Frontend Engineering Lead

description:
Why Patients Need You
Technology impacts everything we do. Pfizer's digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives.
What You Will Achieve
You will help Pfizer build its information technology solutions. You will leverage your technical skills to design, develop and implement IT solutions which satisfy the short term or long terms needs of Pfizer. You will work on systems architecture, network systems and application infrastructure to deliver results.As an associate, your focus on the job will contribute in achieving project tasks and goals. Work with the technical lead to design and develop code in one or more technologies (Java, Python, JavaScript, .Net, Vue). Experience in writing code in at least two languages with minimal supervision.

Perform stringent testing of code written, including designing, and writing automated tests to allow for continuous delivery.
Help the team embrace agile core values, adopt, and apply those principles, and implementation practices.
Foster a learning and development mindset.
Be responsible for a specific application and/or a functionality within an application (e.g. front-end or back-end).

Qualifications
Must-Have

Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
2 years of software development experience.
Experience in either Java, C#, Python or JavaScript programming languages.
Demonstrated ability to effectively document software designs and communicate implementation details.

Nice-to-Have

Master's Degree in Computer Science or related field.
Experience in front-end or back-end frameworks (Angular, vue, Spring, Quarkus).
Cloud-specific experience with Amazon Web Services or Microsoft Azure.
Linux, networking, security.
